baseline.policy: Do not modify, rebuild, or retarget the certified v3.0.1 candidate while the post-release audit is planned.

purpose: Systematic post-v3.0.1 repository regression, simplification, canonical reference-TCC rebuild, distribution documentation repair, and Web/Lite validator end-to-end certification.

audit_method.deletion_policy: No file or branch is deleted solely because static reference search finds no consumer. Dynamic fixtures, generated-input contracts, release evidence and GitHub configuration require semantic review first.

confirmed_findings.finding: template/main.tex mixes numbered and unnumbered chapter filenames, and several numbered filenames no longer describe their current content.

semantic_drift.3-methodology.tex: Formatação geral e organização da parte textual
semantic_drift.formatting-examples.tex: Ilustrações, tabelas e outros objetos acadêmicos
semantic_drift.5-conclusion.tex: Recursos do abntexto-ufc, elementos pós-textuais e revisão final

confirmed_findings.resolution_direction: Rebuild the canonical TCC/reference document with sequential filenames whose names match their didactic content.

confirmed_findings.finding: The seven release-review PDFs are smoke/profile validation fixtures rather than the full reviewer-corrected canonical TCC/reference document.
confirmed_findings.evidence: tests/integration/release-review-pairs.sh generates six profiles from tests/smoke/base-profile.tex and the seventh from template/scientific-article.tex.
confirmed_findings.resolution_direction: Keep smoke fixtures for profile gates, but restore a separate canonical pedagogical TCC reference PDF as a first-class release artifact and review surface.

confirmed_findings.finding: The template and Overleaf bundles contain editable TeX sources but no compiled full canonical TCC/reference PDF. The CTAN archive includes only a deliberately minimal example PDF generated from docs/ctan-example.tex.
confirmed_findings.resolution_direction: Generate the canonical TCC/reference PDF deterministically and include it in the appropriate GitHub distribution surface; separately decide whether a portable/no-institutional-mark form also belongs in the CTAN package.

confirmed_findings.finding: The active tree has only three GitHub Actions workflows; the apparent workflow clutter is primarily historical branch clutter, with more than 100 branches still present.

evidence.branch_pages: branches?per_page=100 has a non-empty second page

confirmed_findings.resolution_direction: Retain the three distinct CI roles unless the audit proves safe consolidation; separately inventory and prune merged/scratch/noop/historical branches after explicit destructive-action approval.

confirmed_findings.finding: The certified v3-roadmap.json is intentionally frozen at pre-publication state and therefore still describes PR merge, exact-main recertification and pkgcheck as pending even though those technical steps have completed.
confirmed_findings.resolution_direction: Redesign post-release state recording so immutable certification does not require changing the certified source SHA; separate candidate policy/state from publication receipts.

confirmed_findings.finding: validator/app.js imports ./normative-catalog.js, but the certified validator/ tree contains only app.js, index.html, validation-contract.json and validation-vectors.json. A directly served validator directory therefore lacks a required module.
confirmed_findings.resolution_direction: Create a deterministic normative-catalog.js generation/publication contract and a deploy/package test that fails if any browser import is missing.

confirmed_findings.finding: Current cross-surface validation executes synthetic verdict/schema vectors extracted from Web/Lite source; it does not feed the canonical generated reference PDF through the actual browser/PDF.js analyze(file, profile) path.
confirmed_findings.evidence: tests/checks/normative_cross_surface.py executes selected source expressions with Node and synthetic JSON vectors.
confirmed_findings.resolution_direction: Add an end-to-end Web/Lite fixture test over the exact canonical PDF and compare canonical check identities/verdict semantics with CLI/Deep while preserving declared capability differences.

confirmed_findings.finding: docs/ contains 31 active files, many of which are phase-end, continuation, certification, hardening or recovery records rather than durable user/developer documentation.
confirmed_findings.resolution_direction: Classify every document as durable contract, current operator guide, release receipt, or removable historical process note; rely on Git history instead of keeping redundant process snapshots in the active tree where possible.

confirmed_findings.finding: tools/ contains 13 utilities, including two encoding-conversion PowerShell scripts whose current production/test consumers are not established by the primary Makefile entrypoints.
confirmed_findings.resolution_direction: Build a consumer graph for all tools before retaining, consolidating or removing them; Windows font preparation remains separately certification-sensitive.

work_packages.name: Freeze and close v3.0.1
work_packages.exit: Keep SHA 111680cd934a4ea55b02f6ffe730ff5260077565 immutable; obtain explicit maintainer visual approval; tag and publish only the certified bytes.

work_packages.name: Whole-repository file and branch census
work_packages.exit: Every one of the 472 tracked files has an explicit lifecycle classification and every live branch has a keep/delete rationale.

work_packages.name: Canonical TCC/reference reconstruction
work_packages.exit: One complete TCC-style reference document teaches each supported ABNT/UFC rule and shows the corresponding abntexto-ufc LaTeX mechanism, with sequential semantically correct source filenames.

work_packages.name: Distribution redesign
work_packages.exit: The full canonical reference PDF is deterministically generated, validated, hashed and present in the intended public bundle(s), while the minimal CTAN example retains its distinct purpose.

work_packages.name: Runtime/API and normative regression
work_packages.exit: All runtime modules, public APIs, normative rules, bibliography behavior, profiles, objects, front/back matter, PDF/A, fonts and negative paths are re-audited with no unexplained residuals.

work_packages.name: Validator Web/Lite repair and E2E certification
work_packages.exit: All browser dependencies are shipped; the public site loads from a clean deployment; the canonical PDF is actually analyzed through Web/Lite; declared shared checks agree with CLI/Deep and deep-only checks remain explicit.

work_packages.name: CI/test/tool simplification
work_packages.exit: Every workflow, runner, fixture, checker and utility has a live consumer and unique responsibility, or is consolidated/removed with equivalent regression coverage.

work_packages.name: Documentation/control-plane simplification
work_packages.exit: Durable docs are minimal and authoritative; historical release process state no longer competes with current facts; certification/publication receipts do not mutate certified source.

work_packages.name: Final clean-room regression
work_packages.exit: Fresh clone/build on supported engines/platform scopes, all distribution bundles, canonical TCC PDF, seven profiles, CLI validator, Web/Lite E2E, pkgcheck and visual review pass from one candidate.

non_goals_until_p0_closed: No retargeting of v3.0.0 or v3.0.1 tags
No branch deletion without a separately reviewed branch-pruning manifest
No deletion based only on grep/reference absence
